params.prompt: Educational animation reference diagram, clean black line art on white, professional textbook style. Title at top: "Accelerating Spacing — A Fall Speeds Up". A simple cartoon character falling from the top left to the bottom right, drawn FIVE times along a dotted path. The gap between each successive drawing gets visibly LARGER — a small gap between drawings 1 and 2, a much larger gap between drawings 4 and 5. Each gap is labelled with a horizontal measure bar reading "1 unit", "3 units", "5 units", "7 units". The character's pose changes as it falls: arms starting to rise, hair and clothing trailing upward more strongly in the later drawings. On the right, a comparison strip labelled "WRONG — even gaps" with a red X, showing the same character falling with identical gaps between every drawing. Footer: "Equal gaps read as floating. A real fall covers more ground every frame.". No other text.
